digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview/sync and reconciler CLI
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must run one ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a single manifest containing arbitrated plan entries plus exact field-level drift detail from that same pass, loading active local-ticket set once without launching reconcile-check or duplicating comparison.
Canonical preview must bypass pass-lock acquisition, purging, stealing, and release; no collateral repository, ref, binding, snapshot, or lock state must be mutated.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check retains all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic bridge_state/reconcile-check.json artifact, and exit behavior unchanged.

Canonical preview and canonical sync emit field-comparable manifest envelope; canonical uncapped live retains manifest with exact applied/failed tally; legacy uncapped LIVE CLI/library/MCP callers retain historical tally-only/no-manifest surface.

Argparse allow_abbrev=False makes abbreviated or unknown options exit with invocation error 2 before reads, locks, or mutation; documented legacy --mode dry-run and --mode reconcile-check remain valid.
Legacy capped canonical sync, bootstrap compatibility modes, and legacy live deletion/tally behavior retain their existing deterministic applied/deferred contracts and observable behavior.
